explicit_validation.explanation: The paper conducts both LLM-based PII detection and human evaluation, but they are used independently without any explicit quantitative or qualitative comparison between the two methods. LLM detection serves as automatic metric calculation while human evaluation provides independent assessment on a subset of summaries.

prompts.notes: Prompt for PII detection is described as 'similar to the one proposed by [reference] shown in Figure [X]' but exact prompt text is not provided in the main text excerpt

guidelines.notes: Human evaluation includes calibration phase with 10 document-summary pairs, three specific questions (Q1-Q3) for evaluation, and mentions participants received guidelines for summary creation and PII annotation

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluation assess PII leakage, but LLM focuses on quantitative metrics while human evaluation focuses on span-level annotation and subjective assessment. Human evaluation also includes summary quality preference which LLM does not assess.
